confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Hualien and Taiwan price levels, not from live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain. Accommodation anchors are less certain because July is peak summer season and rates vary by hotel and by weekday. Cocktail and wine were derived from the beer anchor using a local price relationship (bar cocktails and restaurant wine glasses priced at roughly 2.5 to 3 times draft beer). FX: the 2026-10-15 observation was reported in search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange rates page at https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/frequency/exchange-rates.html. I did not open that page directly, and I did not use a third-party figure for 16 October.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional Taiwanese tourism cities with similar hostel and guesthouse stock, such as Yilan and Taitung, adjusted to Hualien's coastal and Taroko Gorge tourism demand. Restaurant and cafe prices were benchmarked against general Taiwan price levels, discounted from Taipei.
